glosses: to find, to come across, to happen upon (encounter something or somebody in some place or doing some action)

examples.text: Przez Skottasa wezwał nas Attyla. Udaliśmy się do jego namiotu, wokół gęsto obstawionego strażami – wkroczywszy doń zastaliśmy Attylę siedzącego na drewnianym tronie.
examples.translation: Attila summoned us through Skottas. We went to his tent, which was densely surrounded by guards; upon going in, we found Attila sitting on a wooden throne.
examples.english: Attila summoned us through Skottas. We went to his tent, which was densely surrounded by guards; upon going in, we found Attila sitting on a wooden throne.

examples.text: Jeżeli listonosz nie zastanie adresata w mieszkaniu, [...]
examples.translation: If the mailman doesn't find the addressee in his home...
examples.english: If the mailman doesn't find the addressee in his home...

examples.text: A gdy wróciliśmy, w domu zastaliśmy jakiegoś mężczyznę w czarnym skórzanym płaszczu.
examples.translation: And when we came back, we found some guy in a black leather coat in the house.
examples.english: And when we came back, we found some guy in a black leather coat in the house.

examples.text: August przebudował również sam Rzym – nakazał budowę nowych akweduktów, amfiteatru, teatrów, odnowił liczne świątynie. Pozostało po nim powiedzenie, że zastał Rzym ceglany, a zostawił marmurowy.
examples.translation: Augustus also rebuilt Rome itself – he ordered the construction of new aqueducts, amphitheaters, and theaters, and renovated numerous temples. It was said of him later that he found Rome made of bricks and left it made of marble.
examples.english: Augustus also rebuilt Rome itself – he ordered the construction of new aqueducts, amphitheaters, and theaters, and renovated numerous temples. It was said of him later that he found Rome made of bricks and left it made of marble.

examples.text: Jestem w ministerstwie ponad miesiąc i wiele spraw wymagało naprawdę pilnego rozwiązania. Nie było żadnych dokumentów z prac nad wdrożeniem DSA i DGA, żadnych planów na „Cyfrową dekadę”. Wciąż więc na razie wychodzimy z chaosu który zastaliśmy, zamiast przedstawiać plan na całe cztery lata, jednak równolegle nad nim pracujemy.
examples.translation: I've been in the minister's office for more than a month, and a lot of issues have required truly careful responses. There were no documents from the work on the implementation of the D[igital] S[ervices] A[ct] and D[ata] G[overnance] A[ct], no plans for the "digital decade". So, for now, we are still emerging from the chaos we found, instead of presenting a plan for a full four years; however, we are working on it in parallel.

There were no documents from the work on the implementation of the D[igital] S[ervices] A[ct] and D[ata] G[overnance] A[ct], no plans for the "digital decade". So, for now, we are still emerging from the chaos we found, instead of presenting a plan for a full four years; however, we are working on it in parallel.
